authority.this_turn_scope: Prepare the next bounded stage and a deterministic readout prototype; do not claim the native matrix was executed.
authority.old_stages: V0.7 remains complete; no old runner, fixture or stored checker rerun.

hypothesis: On each identical harder task, replacing current-action Q privilege by a current factual one-step expectation may improve early performance beyond FT and CT, including when current Q values are unequal.
known_limit: The candidate still depends on downstream Q and on finite-data probability estimates; it is neither complete replanning nor a guaranteed solution to factual utilization.

ordinary_learning.hybrid_backup_contexts: own visited only, descending topological layer then ascending state and command, cyclic
ordinary_learning.chronology: Snapshot the full greedy policy at episode start, then apply paired per-state exploration; after the real terminal, do chronological real TD, factual counts, and bounded replay/model backups. No mid-episode learning.

fact_model.failure: terminal COLLISION at the current state

candidate.interface: factual_one_step_readout(state, successors, goal, counts, q, failure_reward)
lexicographic_order: max p_hat within exact M1 ties
candidate.unknown_edges: Score both legal actions with the same formula, including declared-prior estimates.
candidate.cost: Two model-edge readout calculations per state whose policy is constructed, distinct from stored-Q learning backups.

environments.role: Simple new-seed structural anchor, not a replay of a V0.7 source/receipt.

branch_unit.numbering: unit j: fork=3*j, A=3*j+1, B=3*j+2; next fork=3*(j+1), final next is goal
branch_unit.mirrors: mirror=1 exchanges command 0 and 1 at every state, including forward destinations
branch_unit.labels: Learner sees opaque local integers, no A/B quality labels or source template id.
branch_unit.probability_test: advance iff the external environment uniform is below that edge's source probability
branch_unit.shortcut_warning: The locally more reliable fork is not the globally more reliable route.

matrix.frozen_clone: full Q, count model, buffer and history, no alias to live learner

randomness.engine: local Python random.Random; not legacy science/workload keys
randomness.train_action_shape_per_seed_mirror_condi: 256 x number of states x 2 (explore switch, random command)
randomness.eval_env_shape_per_seed_mirror_condition: 512 x number of states; shared across checkpoints
randomness.pairing: Same coordinates across arms, no arm in keys. Each state occurs at most once per episode. Alternate commands at a state share its environmental uniform.
randomness.materialization: All exogenous tapes fixed before the first matrix rollout; not given to learners.
randomness.bootstrap_unit: 32 seed blocks, average both mirrors within each seed; reuse a single paired resample index table, never treat rollouts as training replicates

evaluation.exact_evaluator: External reverse-topological Bellman calculation with true source probabilities for each frozen deterministic policy and the optimum; never a learner input.
evaluation.main_metric: Normalized trapezoid AUC of J_pi/J_star over checkpoints 0/8/16/32/64, divide by 64.
evaluation.observed_bank: 512 real episodes at each point, success fraction plus Wilson95 and AUC, separately from analytic policy values.
evaluation.first_target: First checkpoint at or above 0.9*J_star; exact and observed labels separate, unachieved null, regression retained, interval crossing uncertain.
evaluation.common_training_cost: For each case and pair use B=min(actual total train steps); compare completed successes at 0.25/0.5/0.75/1.0 times B.
report_all: paired seed deltas and positive/zero/negative counts

wiring.source: one new branch unit, canonical mirror 0
wiring.arms: all nine paths in new graph interface
training: Forced command 0; fork uniform .1 then A uniform .99; ordinary learning from actual collision.
Own frozen-at-start greedy policy, no exploration, uniforms .1 at all states; ordinary learning.
evaluation: One full frozen clone, uniforms .1 at all states
Same frozen clone, uniforms .99 at all states

budgets.resources: local CPU only, no paid provider or GPU
budgets.parallelism: Only independent seed blocks if useful; a stream and its chronology stay serial.

completion.required: All planned methods on the same new cases, true chronological learning, isolated evaluation, full cost accounting and retained positive/zero/adverse results, with a bounded interpretable conclusion.
completion.failure_handling: Preserve first failure/partial and input bytes, no automatic retry or outcome-conditioned tuning. Version actual technical corrections separately.
